value.name: Asha delays responding
value.description: Asha remains silent and lets the quiet buy her time before answering Whitfield.
evidence: She let the quiet do the work she had not yet decided to do herself
Asha kept her mouth closed a beat longer

value.name: Asha senses a message from Rosa
value.description: Asha feels her phone vibrate and realizes Rosa is likely texting about the boy not answering.
evidence: from inside the coat pocket the phone vibrated against her hip, a single short pulse she felt through the wool
She knew without looking what shape the message took, and she could see the line as if it were already in front of her, Rosa telling her he hadn't picked it up yet, telling her to say why

value.name: Whitfield waits for Asha's explanation
value.description: Whitfield watches Asha closely and waits for her to speak before making the exchange easier for her.
evidence: Whitfield lifted his eyes from the page to her face and waited
Whitfield kept his two fingers where they were on the corner of the page and lifted his eyes to hers, not yet ready to make it easier for her by speaking

value.name: Asha withholds the message
value.description: Asha chooses not to answer the phone or reveal the full truth, weighing the cost of the note against her distance from the boy.
evidence: Asha kept her mouth closed a beat longer, weighing what the narrow sentence on the desk would cost the boy whose name was on it against the ten years of distance she had bought and was still, in this room, trying to keep
She felt the phone go still in her pocket and did not reach for it

value.name: Asha gives a partial explanation
value.description: Asha tells Whitfield there was a timing complication, offering only a procedural version of events.
evidence: "There was a complication with the timing, sir," Asha said
she could give him the procedural shape of the week from here, the unreachable hours, the associate left to file under a name that was not his, and stop there

value.name: Asha conceals the deeper truth
value.description: Asha suppresses the fact that the delay involved a hospital corridor and an unaffordable wire transfer.
evidence: What she did not say yet—that the hours had been a hospital corridor and a wire transfer she could not afford—sat at the back of her teeth
